item.tib: rdzogs chen yang rtse klong chen gyi nges don gyi 'grel ba legs bshad nam mkha'i rgyan 'grel
item.coloph: legs lam legs bshad nam mkha'i rgyan 'grel 'di/ sngon nas sngon sbyangs las sad theg chen gdung/ blo ldan blo gros sbyangs pa tshad slebs nas/ don bzhin don gnyer 'gro blo'i rgyan 'gyur phyir/ rnam 'byed blo las shes rab phun sum tshogs/ dal 'byor lus la tshul khrims rgyan gyis mdzes/ byang chub sems la zhi lhag nor bus phyugs/ bslab gsum legs bshad khur gyi mngon mtho ba'i/ gshen gyi drang srong dka' thub ri khrod pa/ nam mkha' 'od zer blo ldan bzang po yi/ lhag bsam dag pas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ skyabs kyi ston pa rin chen 'od zer gyis/ lung rig tshad ma'i srang la rab bzhal nas/ bon gnas del rar legs sbyar ston pa yi/ bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs dus khyab gyur cig sa pho stag gi dpyid zla'i gza' skar dus tshod bzang po la/ gsal ba g.yung drung lha steng du grub par bgyis pa dge legs 'phel rgyas shog/
